summary: FINAL verification round for Phases C + E + F all PASS. (C) Lasers on /game/2-5 render as layered energy beams: visible red soft glow halo, red beam body, bright WHITE-HOT central core line narrower than body, and pulsing endpoint energy nodes (red-glow + white center) at both terminals. Beam thickness/core brightness flickers via sin(animFrame/5) in renderer.tsx L370-372 — verified in code; two frames ~300ms apart captured for visual confirmation. Physics hitbox unchanged (same state.beams input, VFX never widens the hit line). (C) Loop-rewind ripple captured on /game/2-1 at the ECHO 0/1 -> 1/1 transition: purple expanding ring + cyan outer ring + purple blur orb centred at player spawn (bottom-left), fades within ~30 frames (0.5s) and does not persist across loops — matches rewindRef / showRipple logic in renderer.tsx L446-541. (E) AdMob audit — config.ts: adUnitIds use TestIds in __DEV__ and three REPLACE_WITH_PRODUCTION_* placeholders in prod; adsSupported = Platform.OS === 'android'. interstitial.ts: completedSinceAd reset BEFORE ad.load() (L24), threshold = 3 + random(0..2) = 3/4/5 (L25), 10000ms timeout with cleanup (L58-60), early return on !adsSupported || !areAdsReady() (L19). rewarded.ts: 8000ms timeout, onUnavailable fallback on error/closed/no-load. (F) app.json: expo.version='1.0.3', expo.android.versionCode=4, expo.android.package='com.timeloopscope.game' (unchanged). Regression smoke on /game/1-1: HUD renders (⏸, ECHO 0/0, 1-1 · FIRST STEPS, 10s timer counting down), pause overlay shows PAUSED title with RESUME (primary) / RETRY / LEVELS SciFiButton layout, feet planted on ground tiles, no new console errors beyond pre-existing RN-web deprecation warnings (textShadow*, pointerEvents) and benign WebGL perf hints.
critical_code_review_comments: renderer.tsx is 699 lines — just under the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into renderer-world.tsx / renderer-actors.tsx / renderer-fx.tsx on the next feature touch to keep each module focused.

ads/rewarded.ts uses the string literals 'error' and 'closed' with `as any` casts (L61, L65) for addAdEventListener because RewardedAdEventType only exposes LOADED/EARNED_REWARD. This works but a typed re-export (AdEventType.ERROR / AdEventType.CLOSED) would eliminate the `any` cast — minor cleanliness.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phases C/E/F fully verified: laser 3-layer energy beam VFX, loop-rewind purple/cyan ripple at spawn, AdMob config/interstitial/rewarded all correct, version bumped to 1.0.3 / versionCode 4. Previous iterations covered character alignment, feet-plant, Phase B UI, zoom/camera. The game is a web-preview Expo app on landscape viewport (844x390). Level IDs are /game/{world}-{index}: world-1 has maxEchoes=0 (no rewinds), world-2+ supports echo rewinds. Pause button has testID='hud-pause'. Overall app is production-ready for release build.
